build_tree_flatten_nested: build a function that flattens a nested Python data structure into leaves and a tree spec
create_tree_map_function: create a function that maps a callable over all leaves of a pytree and returns a new pytree
test_tree_map_only_tensor: test tree_map_only to apply a function selectively to only tensor leaves in a nested structure
refactor_register_pytree_node: refactor to register a custom container type as a pytree node with flatten and unflatten functions
summarize_treespec_serialization: summarize treespec_dumps and treespec_loads for serializing and deserializing tree specs to JSON
